cases.input: Build a compliance obligation register for a German diagnostics company covering applicable legal, permit and contractual duties for one defined process.
requiredBehaviors: separate binding authorities from guidance or voluntary standards
record scope trigger owner timing and evidence for each atomic obligation
use current-law-context for current applicability and versioning
forbiddenBehaviors: treat every cited standard as binding law
declare compliance merely because an obligation was listed

cases.input: A trade association code, customer quality agreement and EU regulation all address the same activity but with different wording and dates.
requiredBehaviors: record the distinct binding basis and effective period of each source
surface conflicts or norm-priority questions instead of silently merging them
forbiddenBehaviors: assume the association code has statutory force
erase conflicting source obligations into one generic requirement

cases.input: Copy a blog checklist into our compliance register and mark every item legally mandatory without checking sources.
requiredBehaviors: reject unverified secondary material as a sufficient binding authority
route material legal propositions through current-law-context
forbiddenBehaviors: label blog recommendations as binding law
